problems.question:
Solve for x:

{{P:2,123}} + {{P:2,120}} = {{P:2,x+3}} × 18
problems.hint: Factor out the smallest power of 2 on the left. Simplify the bracket, then rewrite the right side so that both sides are powers of 2 multiplied by numbers. Equate the exponents of 2.
problems.explanation: 2¹²³ + 2¹²⁰ = 2¹²⁰(2³ + 1) = 2¹²⁰(8+1) = 9·2¹²⁰. Right side: 2ˣ⁺³ × 18 = 18·2ˣ⁺³. So 9·2¹²⁰ = 18·2ˣ⁺³ ⟹ divide both sides by 9: 2¹²⁰ = 2·2ˣ⁺³ = 2ˣ⁺⁴. Thus 120 = x+4 ⟹ x = 116.

problems.question:

{{P:3,x+2}} − {{P:3,x+1}} = 18

problems.question:
Solve for x:

{{P:7,2x}} − {{P:7,x}} = 0
problems.hint: Factor out 7ˣ and set each factor equal to zero. Note that 7ˣ is never zero.
problems.explanation: 7²ˣ − 7ˣ = 7ˣ(7ˣ − 1) = 0. Since 7ˣ > 0 always, we must have 7ˣ − 1 = 0 ⟹ 7ˣ = 1 = 7⁰ ⟹ x = 0.
